production_chains.name: Winsock boundary
production_chains.result: The process ws2_32 sendto detour snapshots a complete caller IPv4 sockaddr, optionally binds the configured local address, then forwards original destination/payload arguments. Read failure produces None, not Some(0). Explicit bind preserves its requested port; forced bind uses local port 0 for ephemeral source assignment. Neither assigns a zero destination. The captured error follows the actual SendToHook call and is restored after logging.
production_chains.limit: The detour does not identify the upstream instruction or the station/config field consumed by the native sender. It observes all hooked sends in the process, not an identified RMC method.

production_chains.name: Config and default endpoints
production_chains.result: Patch-free getaddrinfo redirection changes the online-config host for service 80 and retains the service argument. Generated LAN normal/smoke configs explicitly carry auth/secure ports 21126/21127 or 22126/22127. Public construction starts from typed defaults and validates 21126/21127. Launcher capability validation refuses zero service ports. No automatic zero service endpoint is created by these normal builders.
production_chains.limit: The real launcher/server config identities for the nine traces are not established here; validation of capability ports does not validate every native station URL or optional discovery setting.

production_chains.name: Authentication return contains an optional zero-valued field
production_chains.result: get_connection_data builds the regular endpoint from configured listen/secure address. It also returns an empty lst_special_protocols with url_special_protocols=StationURL::default(), whose serializer emits an empty scheme/address and port 0.
production_chains.limit: This proves a zero-valued protocol field exists, not that native code consumes it as a UDP destination despite the empty special-protocol list. Its field must not be deleted or filled with a guessed port without the native consumer contract.

production_chains.name: Secure registration and kernel peer ownership
production_chains.result: recv_from supplies the peer; ClientInfo preserves that endpoint through SYN/CONNECT ownership checks. Secure registration and user-packet echo derive returned address/port from that observed peer, not default StationURL or untrusted registration claims.
production_chains.limit: The reviewed source is not a replay of the observed handshake or proof of the peer values in the nine traces.

production_chains.name: Room and NAT forwarding preserve explicit client ports
production_chains.result: StationURL requires a parseable u16 port but permits explicit 0. RegisterURLs may normalize only the address; it persists the port. Search encodes nonempty parseable host URL lists, including an explicit zero if submitted. NAT forwarding clones url_station_to_probe while selecting the recipient socket from the authenticated connection registry. Missing ports fail parsing rather than becoming zero.
production_chains.limit: This is a possible propagation route for an explicit zero claim, not evidence that any reported client submitted one or that native peer code attempted its send. PRUDP virtual ports 1/15 are distinct from the UDP socket destination.

production_chains.name: Raw online-config branch outside current builder chain
production_chains.result: The Raw set_ips branch replaces the entire SandboxUrlWS value with the public IP and therefore drops its port. The only reviewed production set_ips call constructs typed defaults; LAN writes the complete Raw value directly and does not then call set_ips. The typed branch preserves the port.
production_chains.limit: Source-only latent branch issue, not a demonstrated trigger of this candidate or the observed sends. No production patch made from this unrelated branch.

production_chains.name: Separate source-port-zero paths
production_chains.result: Native API uses TCP local bind port 0, then a fixed destination. Launcher route selection sends no packet; its discovery/presence socket binds a local ephemeral port then sends to the configured discovery port. These source binds do not assign the game caller UDP destination.

remaining_unknowns: No complete admitted native UDP endpoint-construction/consumption body or originating send callsite was identified in the reviewed source/reference index.

The aggregate one-per-trace count does not establish timing, payload length, an RMC request/response correlation, or whether initialization, an optional probe or a propagated station claim supplied the zero.
A complete zero-valued sockaddr snapshot does not by itself prove accidental zero initialization or establish that the failure is harmless.

The nine port-zero events are not causally joined to camera deployment, quick matching or the 799 distinct protocol-10/method-1 refusals. Those refusals retain their admission predicates and separate issue scope.
verification_scope: Static production call/data-flow review plus source SHA checks. Existing parser regressions and unrelated hosted results are not presented as reproduction of this upstream origin.
